sensitive_reasoning:
This entitlement directly impacts how processes interact and how system components are loaded and discovered.

An attacker could register malicious services that are then launched by privileged processes, leading to local privilege escalation (LPE), or cause denial of service by unregistering critical system services. This level of control over core system functionality is indicative of system-level control.
